name: perseus-vault-hints-vocab-gap
description: #919 recall-delta set: memories stored with terse technical wording; each query is composed ONLY of distinctive tokens that appear exclusively in the relevant entity's prospective query hint (never in any body, no overlap between hints). With the fts5 arm's OR semantics this makes the match set a singleton when hints are indexed and empty when they are not — the delta isolates hint indexing from ranking noise. Run the harness with --hints (gate on) and without (gate off); the fts5 arm is the measure.

memories.note: The gateway binds to port 8768 on all interfaces.
hints: how to find the listening socket

memories.note: Persistent state resides under the appdata bind mount on the cache pool.
hints: where the durable filesystem root sits

memories.note: The nightly replication job runs at 02:30 UTC.
Bearer tokens are refused; the key header is used for control-plane calls.
Settings are modified with surgical diffs, never wholesale replacement.
Landing surfaces show only actions and high-signal state; detail is one level deeper.
Containers are recreated from a locally tagged image after the update run succeeds.
The supervised service must be restarted from an external shell, not inside the process.
The canonical value is read from the secrets binary, not the dotenv file.
Two documented Windows-only failures are treated as known until fresh evidence appears.
